title: every Q# names exactly one question record
intention: Every Q# names exactly one question record: no number is read off two records, every [Q#n] marker in the outline has a record carrying n, and outline 0.6 never states a next unused number below the one outline_check mints.
why: Measured 2026-11-24: joined.qnum reads 47 numbers off more than one question record (240 records, all resolved); Q#126 and Q#127 stand in the outline with no record; outline 0.6 says 128 is next while records reach 135. Outline 0.6 reads 'Its #n is its own and never changes', so each is red (Law 9).
traces_to: Law 9 — a broken spec line on disk is red until fixed; Law 1 — a Q# is the address a settled answer is found by.
how: A new proof in outline_check reds the three findings over the live corpus; the build measures each duplicate's source, keeps the earliest record's number and re-reads or re-mints the rest through the question door, writes records for Q#126/127 through the door, and bumps 0.6 to the mint (or points it at the mint if a bump measurably cannot stay true).

clauses.claim: no Q# that joined.qnum reads is carried by two question records
every Q# written in the outline pieces is carried by a question record
outline 0.6's stated next unused number is not below outline_check.next_qnum

decisions.text: D1: a new proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/outline_check/proofs/test_every_q_number_names_one_question.py, one tooth per clause over the live corpus, plus a scratch-corpus tooth per clause so a hollow build reds.

D2: 0.6's by-line (written by 741d532640ac) spells the measurement as '[Q#127] stands at 17-tools.md:50', and joined.markers reads that bracket as a Q#127 marker in 0.6; the outline check of this ticket opened open-4f53f113cd1b ('touches 0.6, where Q#127 stands open') on it. The by-line drops the bracket ('Q#127's marker stands at 17-tools.md:50'), and open-4f53f113cd1b is then answered as a false reading of that bracket.

out: cairn/tools/question (records change only through its door)

measured.saw: 47 Q# numbers on more than one record, 240 records, all resolved, each reading its number from the question text; Q#126 cited at 09-codemother-device.md:267 and [Q#127] at 17-tools.md:50 with no record; 0.6 reads 'now 128' while number_open minted up to Q#135
measured.how: joined.qnum over cairn.tools.question.question._all() and grep Q#12[6-9] over the requirements, house at ec53dff12

measured.saw: cairn outlinecheck b03dce633aa8 opened open-4f53f113cd1b: section 0.6 holds a [Q#127 bracket in its own by-line, so Q#127 reads as standing in two sections
measured.how: cairn outlinecheck b03dce633aa8, record outline_checks/b03dce633aa8-20261124T183357.json; grep -n Q#127 over the requirements
